interpretation.convention: Each complex appears in its own biosynthesis as the +1 product. Reactant participants (monomers, sub-complexes, metabolites, prosthetic groups, RNAs, chaperone substrates) carry positive stoichiometric coefficients indicating how many copies are required to assemble one complex. Negative coefficients (rare) indicate net release.
interpretation.compartments: c=Cytosol, d=DNA, e=Extracellular, m=Membrane, tc=Terminal Organelle Cytosol, tm=Terminal Organelle Membrane
interpretation.monomers: molecule_wid is a ProteinMonomer WCM ID (e.g. MG_003_MONOMER)
interpretation.subcomplexes: molecule_wid is another complex WCM ID (e.g. RIBOSOME_30S inside RIBOSOME_70S)
interpretation.metabolites: molecule_wid is a Metabolite WCM ID; covers metal/cofactor binding (Mg2+, ADP, ATP, etc).
interpretation.chaperones: chaperone substrate participants (typically empty for our complexes)
interpretation.rnas: Gene-level WCM IDs of rRNAs / tRNAs incorporated into the complex
